MaxLineLength:SettingsActivity.kt$SettingsActivity$"Google only lets apps reach Nest through its Device Access program, so this needs a one-time setup (about 15 minutes, and Google charges a one-time US$5 Device Access registration fee):
1. DEVICE ACCESS CONSOLE: register (accept the terms, pay the fee).
2. GOOGLE CLOUD: create a project › enable “Smart Device Management API” › OAuth consent screen: External, add your Gmail as a test user, then PUBLISH APP (otherwise Google unlinks you every 7 days) › Credentials › Create OAuth client ID › Web application › Authorized redirect URI: https://www.google.com. Keep the client ID and secret.
3. Back in the Device Access Console: Create project › paste the OAuth client ID › copy the Project ID.
4. Enter the three values below, tap LINK ACCOUNT, sign in, choose your home and allow the thermostat. Google then shows its home page: copy the whole address from the address bar and tap PASTE GOOGLE LINK."
